## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Usage: python3 ip/ai/npu/scripts/make_tiny_model.py --out <file.pt> [--n 128] [--seed 1] [--classes 0,2]
[--top 1.5] [--conf 0.1] [frames.gif ...]  (frames: calibration inputs for the class biases; default none:
biases from random frames).
```

Per function:

```text
build: The scaled-down YOLOv8 with seeded random weights (BatchNorm at its defaults).

batch: The frames letterboxed to n x n as the model's input (N x 3 x n x n, 0 .. 1).

unit_scale: Data-driven rescale (LSUV): in forward order, each convolution's weights scaled so its output has a
standard deviation of 1 on the frames. Random weights alone shrink the activations layer by layer
(the output stops depending on the input); after this every layer carries the frame's content.

class_logits: The class convolutions' outputs (logits, per class over every anchor of every level and frame).

tune_biases: Bias offsets: the box bins biased towards short distances (BOX_SLOPE); for each class in classes the
(100 - top) percentile of its logits lands just above the threshold's logit; every other class far below
it.
```
